sources.title: 2026 Formula One World Championship regulations
sources.notes: The brief's category 110 page remains an umbrella archive; category 2182 is the canonical 2026 listing.

sources.title: 2026 Formula 1 Sporting Regulations, Section B, Issue 08
facts: B7.2.1(c) limits use of a qualifying recharge floor below 5 MJ to no more than four of at most twelve affected competitions.

sources.title: 2026 Formula 1 Technical Regulations, Section C, Issue 20
facts: C2.3.3 limits wheelbase to 3400 mm.

C3.10.10 and C3.11.6 require front and rear Straight Mode to decrease flap incidence, settle within 400 ms and return to Corner Mode on failure; they do not publish a decrease angle or aerodynamic force coefficient.
C4.1 defines 726 kg plus Nominal Tyre Mass for Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying, and 724 kg plus Nominal Tyre Mass for other sessions.
C4.7 assigns Nominal Tyre Mass measurement and later publication to the tyre provider; Issue 20 contains no public numeric Nominal Tyre Mass.
C5.2.7-C5.2.8 define the 350 kW absolute MGU-K DC cap and the Normal, Overtake and Race/Sprint power-limited speed curves.
C5.2.9 limits the Energy Store maximum-to-minimum state-of-charge window to 4 MJ.
C5.2.10(ii) changes the qualifying recharge floor from 5 MJ to 4 MJ.
C5.2.8(iii) and (iv) apply during any power-limited period.
C5.2.12 normally withholds standing-start positive MGU-K torque until 50 km/h and permits the stated SECU minimum-acceleration safety exception.

sources.title: Building a stronger future: updated regulations approved by World Motor Sport Council
facts: In low-grip conditions Boost may only prevent a power reduction and may not increase output.
Overtake is disabled in the affected low-grip condition.

sources.title: F1's New Era: Everything you need to know about how the FIA is making Formula 1 more competitive, more sustainable and safer in 2026
facts: Straight Mode moves both front and rear flaps and reduces overall drag.
Corner Mode is the high-downforce position.
Straight Mode is available at predetermined points on straights of a minimum length and is independent of the following-car gap used for Overtake.
limitations: The published 30 percent downforce and 55 percent drag changes compare vehicle generations; they are not Corner-to-Straight mode deltas and are not model coefficients.

sources.title: F1 - 2026 Australian Grand Prix Post-Race Press Conference Transcript
facts: A driver described loss of front-end response and understeer while using Straight Mode, including when moving out of a slipstream.
limitations: Qualitative validation evidence only; it supplies no coefficient, target speed or calibration value.

sources.title: 2026 Belgian Grand Prix Circuit Map, Pit Lane Drawing, Emergency Exits Map and Red Zone

sources.title: 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix Circuit Map, Pit Lane Drawing, Emergency Exits Map and Red Zone
